source: Registers hold the values a thread needs directly for instruction execution: loop counters, pointers, fragments of matrix tiles, intermediate arithmetic results, and accumulators. ZXNAME0000XZ automatic scalar variables generally reside in registers unless the compiler chooses another placement.[1]
zh: 寄存器保存线程执行指令直接所需的值：循环计数器、指针、矩阵块片段、中间算术结果和累加器。 ZXNAME0000XZ 自动标量变量通常驻留在寄存器中，除非编译器选择其他位置。[1]
